score_observations: Visually inspected opening page: movement I Forcefully, dotted quarter=140, starts 9/8 and alternates 6/8, 9/8 and 12/8.
Saxophone opening combines slurs, accents, staccato eighth notes, changing accidentals and ledger-line pitches above staff.
Piano has independent rhythmic entries and chromatic chords; this is a duo score, not a simple melody-only arrangement.
